Parser PR91 changes the branch to route hex/octal/character/general and other integer formats through format_int, and exponent/fixed/percentage through format_float, adding regression assertions for every reported false-value format. RustPython PR5012 changes the parser/format dependency from b2f95e2 (does not contain PR91) to69d27d9 (contains it). Current monorepo retains those branches.
